formatted_sql:
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name
FROM dim_customers AS c
WHERE
  NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    WHERE
      o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed'
  )
ORDER BY
  c.customer_id ASC
